# Buildora Materials

> Buildora Materials Trading LLC is a building and electrical materials supplier based in Ajman, UAE, serving contractors, developers and project teams across Ajman, Sharjah, Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the wider UAE. 21 product categories, 50+ globally certified brands.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://buildoramaterials.com/): Company overview, product categories, brands, and contact details.
- [Products](https://buildoramaterials.com/products.html): Full catalogue — electrical materials, cables & wires, cable management, plumbing, HVAC, LED lighting, safety equipment, power tools, paints, sanitary ware, water pumps, hardware and more.
- [About](https://buildoramaterials.com/about.html): Company background and operations.
- [Brands](https://buildoramaterials.com/brands.html): Globally certified brands stocked, including ABB, Schneider Electric, Ducab, Jotun, Makita, Bosch, Grundfos, Honeywell, Legrand, Philips, Hager, DeWalt, Grohe.
- [Why Us](https://buildoramaterials.com/why-us.html): Quality assurance, delivery, and technical support differentiators.
- [Contact](https://buildoramaterials.com/contact.html): Location, phone, email, and enquiry form.
- [Blog](https://buildoramaterials.com/blog.html): Technical guides on material sizing, specification and selection for UAE contractors and MEP teams.
